title: ProRes-Det: Projector Restoration and Detection

creators.name: Lee, JeongHyeon
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Gyeongsang National University

description:
A camera pointed at a projected screen sees the projector's light on top of the scene. ProRes-Det removes that light from the capture and scores object detection on the same frame before and after restoration, so the benefit of the restoration is measured rather than asserted.

Restoration (NAFSE-UNet and a basic CNN baseline) and detection (SSDLite and YOLO11) are registry-selected backends behind one image contract, so either stage is replaced through configuration without touching the pipeline. Offline evaluation, replay of a recorded session and a live webcam-plus-projector rig share one code path.

The archive includes scene-disjoint train / validation / test splits (3,000 / 200 / 1,000 pairs) and all trained checkpoints, so the offline evaluation runs without projector-camera hardware.
notes: This repository is MIT licensed. It additionally redistributes weights/detector_yolo11s.pt, a fine-tune of an Ultralytics YOLO11 checkpoint, under AGPL-3.0; the default configuration uses SSDLite (BSD-3-Clause) instead. See THIRD_PARTY.md in the archive for the full third-party accounting.
